scripts.bootstrap: npm run migrate && npm run import:legacy && npm run ingest:register -- --all && npm run ingest:listings && npm run match
scripts.migrate:streets: npm run migrate && (npx tsx src/ingest-register.ts --backfill 8 || echo "register backfill failed; the daily job will retry") && (npm run build-streets || echo "build-streets failed; the daily job will retry") && (npm run build-homes || echo "build-homes failed; the daily job will retry") && (npx tsx src/match.ts || echo "match failed; the daily job will retry") && (npm run build-worth || echo "build-worth failed; the daily job will retry") && (npx tsx src/ingest-planning.ts --if-empty || echo "ingest-planning failed; the daily job will retry")
